literal_meaning: দু'হাত ও দু'পা ধরে দেহ ঝুলিয়ে বহন
figurative_meaning_bn: দু'হাত ও দু'পা ধরে দেহ ঝুলিয়ে বহন
figurative_meaning_en: Carrying a person by holding their hands and feet and dangling the body
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওকে চ্যাঙদোলা করে তুলে নিয়ে যাও।
আহত বন্ধুকে চ্যাঙদোলা করে হাসপাতালে নিয়ে গেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: Carry him by making a swing and take him away.
We carried the injured friend to the hospital by dangling him between us.
note: Refers to a traditional method of carrying someone in rural or informal settings, evoking imagery of a makeshift swing.
